title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #1
body: Get into LUMS, or get into UCP and say "I was going to do LUMS but." If you hear "Papa's mills are in Sheikhupura," "the farm is on Bedian," or "we're shifting to Phase 6," you're getting warmer. Never skip a dinner where someone says "the driver will bring the car around, wait inside." Then ask where they live. If they answer "Gulberg" with a block and stop, no landmark, no explanation, you're extremely warm. It's a sealed deal if they say "yaar the valet at Aylanto is so slow" and mean it sincerely.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #2
body: Ask which school and count the words. Aitchison is one word and the conversation moves on. LGS gets a branch attached, "LGS 55 Main," "Paragon," and everyone at the table instantly re-sorts. If they say "I did my O Levels" and never name the place, that's the highest tier, that's someone who assumes you already know. It's a sealed deal when two strangers find out they were in the same section in 2013 and the entire evening changes shape.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #3
body: Position yourself correctly on MM Alam, because it is four different crowds by the hour. Aylanto at nine on a Friday. Cosa Nostra when it's a date. English Tea House when a mother is joining. If they park across two spaces and the valet says nothing, warm. If they say "just put it on the account," warmer. It's a sealed deal if the bill has never once arrived at their table because their father opened that account in 2006.

You cannot buy this, the waiting list is measured in decades, and everyone applying knows it. title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #5

If you hear "we're doing Dubai till the AQI drops," you are extremely warm. It's a sealed deal if a child in that house has never had a winter cough and nobody there finds that remarkable.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #6
body: There are two lobbies and you keep aiming at the loud one. Phase 8 with the glass front and the pillars is money born after 2015. The real one is a sixties house in Gulberg with a lawn too big to maintain and a kitchen nobody has touched since 1994. No posts. No highlights. A surname the waiter at Cuckoo's Den already knows. It's a sealed deal if they fix everything with one phone call and genuinely think that's how phones work.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #7
body: Wedding season runs December to February and the cards on the fridge are a map. Royal Palm, the PC, Nishat, or a farmhouse off Raiwind with eight hundred guests. If they say "we've got nine functions this month" like it's a burden, warm. If the outfit is a designer's name said like a friend's, warmer. It's a sealed deal if they can tell you which two families are marrying and the actual reason behind it.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Lahore. Tip #8
body: Ask what the family does and count the words. "Textiles." One word, no elaboration, and the follow-up gets a polite nothing. That's the mills. "We're in construction, and property, and my uncle has the franchise" is four answers and one of them pays. It's a sealed deal if a factory is named by which city it's in rather than what it makes.
